blogPosts.title: The Discipline of Doing Less, Better
blogPosts.excerpt: On why the most effective body composition plans are often the most restrained.
blogPosts.author: Coach Meera
content: The clients who see the most refined results rarely follow the most aggressive plans — they follow the most consistent ones.
A measured caloric deficit, adequate protein, and two to three well-coached strength sessions a week will outperform an extreme regimen followed for three weeks and abandoned.
We review progress in trends over weeks, not days, and we adjust deliberately rather than reactively.
The goal is never a dramatic before-and-after. It's a plan refined enough to become simply how you live.

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect the information provided when you join or contact us — name, email, phone number, and billing details necessary to process payments.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your information is used to manage your membership, communicate about sessions and schedule changes, and process payments. We do not sell member data to third parties.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You may request a copy of the data we hold about you, or ask us to delete it, at any time.

sections.heading: Membership terms
sections.body: Memberships are billed monthly and may be cancelled with 30 days notice.

sections.heading: Facility use
sections.body: Members are expected to re-rack equipment and follow posted class capacity limits.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: Exercise carries inherent risk. Members are responsible for training within their own limits and consulting a physician before starting a new program if needed.
